determinism: same input yields byte-identical output; the card carries no clock, counter, or entropy

withheld_snapshot_fields.reason: Operator-supplied free text that can carry a local filesystem path or an argument copied from a private repository, so it stays on the machine even though the Snapshot itself may show it.

estimate_band.reason: A band is a word, not free text. Letters and single spaces admit no digit, path separator, URL, address, or key material.

limitations.const: Snapshot is an ESTIMATE only. It is not a performed assessment.

forbidden_field_names_are_illustrative: A named list cannot be exhaustive, so the projection is default-deny: any field outside allowlisted_fields is refused whether or not it appears above.
refusal: unknown/private fields may leak into a share card.
